subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should OpenClaw pursue this default-off `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` config, switch to the newer default-on successor path, or keep strict `message_tool_only` semantics with no recovery?
rationale: The code path is reviewable, but choosing whether private final text should be replayed through an opt-in retry, recovered by default, or kept strictly private is a product/privacy contract decision automation cannot safely make.

options.title: Prefer successor after refresh
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99536 as the canonical path only after it is refreshed, exact-head proof is current, and maintainers accept default-on recovery.

options.title: Accept this opt-in config
options.body: Keep this PR's default-off recovery surface, require real external chat proof, and document the operator-controlled privacy tradeoff before merge.

options.title: Keep strict tool-only behavior
options.body: Reject recovery and leave `message_tool_only` as no-message-call means no source reply, relying on stronger prompts/models or automatic visible replies instead.

recommendation.title: Prefer successor after refresh
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99536 as the canonical path only after it is refreshed, exact-head proof is current, and maintainers accept default-on recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: The likely decision is a core delivery/privacy policy choice, and steipete merged the current warning-only behavior that this PR changes.
